title: System Developer
_note: Tasks from eMASCO (emasco.mohr.gov.my/masco/2512), fetched 21 Oct 2026. Questions are ours; each cites the task it was built from.

questions.text: Describe a system you designed with more than one part, such as a front end, a back end and a database. How did the parts talk to each other?
questions.source: eMASCO 2512, task 2: Menyelidik, mereka bentuk dan membangunkan sistem perisian komputer.

questions.text: How did you test a system you built before you handed it over? What did you check, and why?
questions.source: eMASCO 2512, task 4: Membangun dan mengarahkan pengujian perisian dan pengesahan prosedur.

questions.text: Tell us about a time a user or client asked for a change to something you built. How did you handle it?
questions.source: eMASCO 2512, task 8: Merujuk pelanggan berhubung dengan penyelenggaraan sistem perisian.
